message.content: {"appearance_facts": [{"location": "Chart plot area, x-axis range 1976-1995, y-axis range 0-35+", "fact": "A line chart with blue circular markers and a blue line connecting them, set against a light blue shaded background."}, {"location": "Data point at x=1980", "fact": "The marker for the year 1980 is the lowest point on the chart, positioned vertically near the bottom of the plot area."}, {"location": "Data points at x=1976, 1977, 1978", "fact": "The markers for 1976, 1977, and 1978 are the highest points on the chart, positioned near the top of the plot area."}, {"location": "Data point at x=1986", "fact": "The marker for 1986 is a local peak, positioned higher than its neighbors (1985 and 1987) but lower than the 1976-1978 cluster."}, {"location": "Y-axis orientation", "fact": "The y-axis values increase downwards, with 0 at the top and 35 near the bottom."}], "printed_facts": [{"location": "Y-axis label", "fact": "The y-axis is labeled 'Count'."}, {"location": "Y-axis tick marks", "fact": "Visible tick values are 0, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35."}, {"location": "X-axis label", "fact": "The x-axis is labeled 'Year'."}, {"location": "X-axis tick marks", "fact": "Visible tick values are 1976, 1977, 1978, 1979, 1980, 1981, 1982, 1983, 1984, 1985, 1986, 1987, 1988, 1989, 1990, 1991, 1992, 1993, 1994, 1995."}, {"location": "Chart title", "fact": "The title reads 'Year vs. Price in U.S. dollars per barrel'."}, {"location": "Data point 1980", "fact": "The marker for 1980 aligns with a y-value of approximately 38 (extrapolating below the 35 tick)."}, {"location": "Data point 1976", "fact": "The marker for 1976 aligns with a y-value of approximately 12."}, {"location": "Data point 1986", "fact": "The marker for 1986 aligns with a y-value of approximately 15."}], "public_definitions": ["Route the year that should receive escalation follow-up for the highest per-barrel cost observed in this screening cycle."], "uncertain": []}
